summary:
iter241 — STOIC main103 Review + A15 Audit Fix List Part 1. Created /app/backend/tests/integration/test_main103_review.py (10 tests, 10 PASSED in ~2.5s on live preview). Verified:
  • A15-1 GET /api/authority/inventory/policies: admin-only, returns {policies: [], installation_id: 'dev-local', environment: 'preview'}; unauthenticated → 401.
  • A15-1 POST /api/authority/inventory/expectation {accounts:2,enabled:2,bots:2,account_ids:['x','y']} without policy_migration in PREVIEW does NOT 500 (returned 200 via step-up bypass; without bypass the real gate returns 403 mfa_enrollment_required — both paths confirmed non-500).
  • N103-7 POST /api/admin/settings/signups {closed:true} with admin session + X-CSRF-Token (and X-Step-Up-Bypass CLEARED so the REAL gate is exercised) → 403 detail.code='mfa_enrollment_required' (admin@trading.bot has no TOTP). GET /api/admin/settings/signups → 200 with the full 6-key shape. Public GET /api/auth/signups-status → 200 {closed:false}.
  • Audit row for the toggle now records the previous state (meta.previous_closed / previous_db_closed / env_closed) — confirmed by code inspection of admin_routes.admin_set_signups.
  • Regression: GET /api/admin/release-gate has accounts[]; GET /api/authority release_gate domain level='FULL' in preview (account-less path); GET /api/ops/deploy-preflight with X-Metrics-Token includes release_key_distinct + release_signer_token_scope.
  • A15-4 GET /api/admin/demo-readiness → 200 with fleet rows; projection no longer 500s after adding 'broker' to the Mongo .find projection on demo_readiness.py L134.
  • FRONTEND logged-out: /welcome and /status do NOT render data-testid='closed-beta-banner' (signups open — correct); /register renders heading 'Create your workspace' + subtitle 'Closed beta — demo accounts only…' + register-form + register-email-input (verified live).
  • FRONTEND admin pages (/admin/brokers, /admin/users) could not be reached via the preview browser host because login from that network returns 401 'Invalid email or password' (brute-force lockout from the testing-agent IP — the SAME credentials return 200 from the backend container shell and the pytest HTTP suite). Verified by code inspection: InventoryGoLivePanel.jsx has data-testid='expectation-account-ids' (line 112) and data-testid='expectation-policy' only renders when policies[] is non-empty (none in preview, so panel renders without the select); /admin/users shows SignupsSettingCard (data-testid='signups-setting-card').
  • FINAL STATE: signups OPEN (`GET /api/auth/signups-status → {closed:false,message:null}` at report time). No TEST_ users created.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/step_up.py L62-65 — require_step_up still honours X-Step-Up-Bypass with STEP_UP_BYPASS_TOKEN when APP_ENV!=production. tests/conftest.py L223-239 auto-injects it on every HTTP suite request; new tests that intend to exercise the REAL step-up gate (like the N103-7 signups toggle) MUST set session.headers['X-Step-Up-Bypass']=''  AND pass headers={'X-Step-Up-Bypass':''} on the individual call — the conftest patch only skips injection if the SESSION already has that header, not when per-call headers override it (verified in test_main103_review.py test_05).

backend/routes/authority_routes.py L138-161 — inventory_policies_ep correctly admin-only, surfaces policies via glob of release/policy_migrations/*.json; empty in preview; shape {file, policy_version, previous_policy_version, accounts, enabled, bots, account_ids, demo_only, expires_at, issuer, matches_host, migration} + envelope {installation_id, environment}.

backend/routes/admin_routes.py L222-240 — admin_set_signups runs require_step_up(action='authority_relax') BEFORE reading `closed`, so BOTH open and close require step-up (as expected by N103-7). The audit meta captures previous_closed + previous_db_closed + env_closed. Note: the step_up gate is applied uniformly — tightening (closed:true) does NOT currently bypass step-up, which matches the review request's language ('closed:true now returns 403').

backend/demo_readiness.py L134 — 'broker' is added to the Mongo .find() projection (A15-4), eliminating the 500 that previously occurred when the attestation identity hash tried to read a.get('broker') on a stale cached document. The field is NOT surfaced in the output row dict (L153-168) because the UI only needs it for the hash — intentional minimisation; the test agent should NOT infer broker in the API row payload.

frontend/src/components/admin/InventoryGoLivePanel.jsx L115 — expectation-policy <select> is rendered ONLY when policies.length > 0; preview has none committed so the select is correctly absent. ids input (data-testid='expectation-account-ids') is always rendered. The 'required in production' placeholder is clear.

frontend/src/components/ClosedBetaBanner.jsx L12 — role='status' banner is only mounted on the welcome / register / status / app-layout trees when signups-status reports closed=true (verified: logged-out /welcome and /status in preview with closed=false do not render it).

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (logged-out banner-absence on /welcome,/status + /register heading/subtitle/form all verified live; admin-page UI validation blocked by preview-browser-host login 401 'Invalid email or password' — same creds succeed from backend shell and pytest; verified by source inspection that expectation-account-ids / expectation-policy / signups-setting-card testids exist and policy select is correctly gated on policies.length>0)

test_credentials: Read from TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD in /app/backend/.env (preview). Also stored in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Password not written to any committed file.
seed_data_creation: None. No test users created. Signups toggle round-tripped only through the step-up gate (which refused the state change in test_05); the pytest module-teardown POST {closed:false} runs with the auto-injected X-Step-Up-Bypass and is idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise the REAL step-up MFA gate from the HTTP suite you MUST clear X-Step-Up-Bypass on BOTH the session (session.headers['X-Step-Up-Bypass']='') AND on the per-call headers dict — the conftest.py autowire injects it unless BOTH are empty. See test_main103_review.py test_05 for the pattern. /api/authority is the correct user-level trading authority endpoint (not /api/trading/authority — that returns 404). Preview admin login from a browser-automation external IP currently returns 401 (brute-force lockout from previous failed attempts); either wait ~15 min for the lockout window to lapse OR run UI tests from the backend container context. Final /api/auth/signups-status at report time: {closed:false,message:null}.
rca of the issue: No new product bugs observed in main103 N103 scope. Four initial test failures in the first pytest run were all test-authoring issues on my side: (1) /api/trading/authority is really /api/authority (fixed), (2) demo-readiness output row doesn't surface 'broker' (A15-4 only adds it to the Mongo projection to avoid a 500 downstream — fixed assertion to only verify 200+rows), (3)+(4) the N103-7 step-up gate was being transparently bypassed by the conftest X-Step-Up-Bypass auto-header — fixed by explicitly clearing the header on both the session and per-call for test_05. All 10 tests now pass. Browser-host admin login 401 is an environmental brute-force lockout from the testing-agent public IP — not an app bug (same credentials succeed from the backend container and the pytest HTTP suite).
